planner_rules.d_pool: D packs run last on DX8-2 Channel 1, in number order, only when ticked as flown.
steps: Select the flown series and include every active pack in them. Empty and pulled slots are skipped: a pulled pack gets no storage charge, and nothing is reordered.
Order each channel by series, then by pack number.
Append the D pool packs that were ticked as flown to their channel (last on DX8-2 Channel 1).
On each charger, run Channel 1 and Channel 2 in rounds: start Channel 1, then Channel 2, and wait for both before the next round. When one channel is empty, the other continues alone.
Count the files per charger: one log file per pack.

start_order.rule: On each charger, start Channel 1, then Channel 2, then wait for both to finish before the next round. When one channel runs out, the other carries on.
start_order.mapping: Logs map by charger, channel and order (one log file per pack).

rest_tests_in_place.applies_when: a pack sat unflown for 5 days or more between storage nights
rest_tests_in_place.compare: first line of its next storage log against its last storage end
rest_tests_in_place.grading: excess = suspect cell drop minus the median drop of the other cells, scaled to 7 days. PASS 10 mV or less, BORDERLINE 10-30 mV, FAIL over 30 mV. A FAIL is a note; it becomes a pull only through the pull rules or a cell under 3.0 V.
rest_tests_in_place.needs: the upload note lists the flown series or packs; days since last use are recorded with the night

notes: Charge every series that was flown, all of it, including any packs in it that did not fly. Series that were not flown stay off.
Each pack has a permanent home channel; empty slots are skipped and nothing is reordered.
Each channel runs in series order, then pack order. On each charger, start Channel 1, then Channel 2, and wait for both before the next pair.
D-1 charges on its own, last on DX8-2 Channel 1, on nights it flew.
Add the flown series or packs and the days since last use to the upload note.
Every pack charges on its own parallel board. Watch is a note only.
The 0.60 V rest check applies only when packs are actually connected in parallel; a pack outside it charges alone that time only.
A pulled pack is skipped, not charged: its slot is skipped like an empty slot and nothing is reordered.

A pack is taken off its board only for safety (puffing or damage, heat, a resting cell under 3.0 V, or a cell spread over 0.20 V) or for sustained failure (an IR Caution night or a cell 100 mV or more low, on 3 of its last 4 storage nights).
IR trend, board IR match and single-cell IR are notes only.
IR from both DX8 chargers is validated against their screens.
